name: 卡蒂
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:215
who: Katie of the Wetze family, a nineteen-year-old human guard at a camp on the edge of the dead zone, a beacon-watcher who sees the first spark of fire from tens of miles away: 172 cm, tall, lean and long-legged, the kind who covers a staircase in half the steps. Straw-coloured hair in one thick braid down her back, the end tied with a short length of sheep-marking wool cord of the village kind. Hazel eyes that light up first when there is a fire at night. The tip of her nose and both cheeks permanently reddened by the wind at the top of the tower. An old pale sling-cord scar across the base of her LEFT thumb (on the viewer's right when she faces us). An honest, quick, outdoor look, a girl who never complains about a night on the tower.
build: 172 cm, tall, lean and long-limbed: thin but strong shoulders and back, a B-cup, a narrow waist and lightly rounded hips.
palette: soft grey wool and scorched brown, straw gold, hazel, wind-red cheeks, a little sheepwool white
casual: Her everyday wear as a camp guard: a plain grey wool guard's coat of the standard issue with the elbows worn thin and one cuff scorched through with a small burnt hole; a sling-cord of woven sheep wool wound round her waist, made by her father, with a small leather pouch on it for the crystal cartridges the camp hands out; a short spear carried over her back; sturdy lace-up boots. Her braid hangs over one shoulder with its wool cord. She stands easy with one hand on the pouch, an alert, open look.
private: Off duty in the camp: a loose long-sleeved undyed wool shirt, plain dark trousers and soft boots, the braid undone to a loose tail tied with the wool cord. She holds a mug of hot barley water in both hands, a relaxed, sleepy look.
battle: Standing her watch on the beacon tower: the grey guard's coat belted with a broad strap, leather bracers marked with faint rune lines, the pouch of crystal cartridges glowing softly at her belt. She whirls the woven sling-cord in her right hand ready to throw a cartridge, the short spear held low in her left, feet apart on the tower's edge, her eyes fixed on a far spark in the dark.
formal: At the camp's muster at dawn: the standard grey guard's coat brushed clean but plainly worn, elbows thinned to a pale patch and one cuff burned through with a small hole, folded open at the neck over a linen shirt with a thread stripe sewn at the cuff. A dark leather pouch at her belt with the corner of a crystal cartridge showing, the sling-cord of sheep wool coiled beside it, a few chips of floating stone sewn into the belt strap that drift a little. The braid wound and pinned, the short spear grounded at her side. She stands very straight, a proud, steady look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly toward a far light, the hazel eyes bright and wide as if a spark has just appeared in the distance, a small closed-mouth smile. Orange beacon-fire light from one side and cold blue dusk from the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and a coil of sheep-wool cord. She wears the grey guard's coat.

name: 君特
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:271
who: Gunter, a sixty-seven-year-old human attendant of the emperor, who carries the oak lamp box on his back: about 170 cm, medium height, his back bent from years of carrying the box though his neck is still straight, sturdy-boned. Very short-cropped white hair, two long white eyebrows that hang over the corners of his eyes, and under them faded blue eyes. A large nose with a permanently reddened tip from lamp oil. Big-jointed hands with a thick callus across the palms from holding ladders. A quiet, patient, old-servant air. He wears no glasses and no jewellery.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old man's weathered face, deep lines at the eyes and either side of the mouth; long white eyebrows overhanging the faded pale blue eyes, which are kind and tired; a large nose with a red tip; sunken cheeks and a firm, thin mouth; short white hair.
build: 170 cm, medium height, bent at the back from carrying the lamp box but with a broad, sturdy frame, thick-boned wrists and big hands.
palette: faded grey and washed-out blue, oak brown, brass, lamp-oil gold, white hair
casual: His everyday wear: a faded, washed-out grey coat of the same issue as the emperor's own, worn at the elbows; on his back an oak lamp box with brass-bound corners, a small lamp burned into its lid; at his belt an old round shield whose paint is half gone. Plain dark trousers, worn boots. He stands with his hands on the straps of the box, a patient look.
private: Resting at the edge of a camp: the grey coat unbuttoned, the lamp box set down beside him on the ground, a wool scarf at his neck. He polishes a small brass lamp with a rag, holding it close to his face, a gentle, absorbed look.
battle: Guarding the emperor on a windy night: the grey coat belted with a strap, the oak lamp box on his back with the small lid-lamp flame burning steady in the wind, the old round shield raised in front of him in his left hand with faint worn rune lines under the half-gone paint, a small lit hand-lamp in his right, feet planted, a stubborn, calm look.
formal: At the emperor's side at a muster: the same plain grey issue coat as the emperor's own, brushed and fastened with a leather strap and two plain buttons, cuffs scorched and darned, a folded soft grey scarf at the throat. The oak lamp box on his back with its brass corners polished and a tiny flame in the lamp burned into its lid that never goes out, the old round shield hung at his belt. His white hair combed flat, standing very upright despite the bent back, a dignified, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the faded blue eyes looking out kindly from under the long white eyebrows. Warm lamp light from the box's open lid below on one side, cool grey dawn from the other. Foreground blur: the small lamp's flame and a rung of a wooden ladder. He wears the faded grey coat.

name: 佩格
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:327
who: Peg of the Longwheel family, a fifty-two-year-old halfling wagon-driver on the grain road from the rail head to the camp: about 98 cm, short, round and thick-waisted with sturdy calves, a halfling's childlike proportions and soft round face. Ginger curly hair tied into one bunch with a red cloth strip in the Longwheel manner. Grass-green eyes that crease shut first when she laughs. A round face with a row of freckles across the bridge of the nose. Hands covered in rein calluses; on the back of her RIGHT hand an old mule-bite scar (on the viewer's left when she faces us). A hearty, shouting, warm air: she scolds her mules loudly and loves them. Fully covered by her clothes.
palette: ginger and grass green, greasy leather brown, small brass bell gold, red cloth, black iron
casual: Her everyday driver's wear: a greasy glossy leather apron with a ring of small brass bells sewn along its hem, as the road rule says anyone on a wagon wears bells; under it a plain rolled-sleeve wool shirt and brown skirt to the ankle; a long-handled wooden ladle at her belt, a tin tube on her back holding the year's long scroll; beside her on the wagon the corner of a black iron cooking pot with a chipped rim. Her ginger hair bunched with the red cloth strip. A cheerful, shouting look.
private: At rest at a camp fire beside her wagon: the apron off, a plain wool shirt with the sleeves rolled and a long brown skirt, soft boots, the red cloth strip loosened. She stirs a pot with the ladle, a warm, contented smile.
battle: Driving through the night on the grain road: a worn canvas short jacket over the leather apron with its bells buckled on, a thick scarf, fingerless gloves, a coil of mule reins gripped in both hands, a lantern with a crystal core hung from the wagon beam. She does not fight, she shouts and does not slow down.
battle_pose: 3) the grain-road outfit: standing braced with the feet apart, a coil of mule reins gripped in both hands, the bells on her apron shaking, shouting forward with a fierce, determined look; she does not fight.
formal: At the supply camp's feast night: a clean short jacket of heavy undyed canvas with patched elbows over a deep green wool dress to the ankle, a ring of small brass bells polished along the hem of her leather apron, a fresh red cloth strip in her hair, a plain thread stripe at each cuff. The bells give a faint chime without moving. The tin tube slung at her back, hands on the apron strings, a broad, proud smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the grass-green eyes creasing shut in a big laugh, a few freckles lit. Warm cooking-fire light from one side. Foreground blur: steam from a pot and the swaying brass bells of her apron hem. She wears the leather apron.

name: 玛伦
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:466
who: Maren of the Hundred-Lamp chain-boat family from Chainhead Harbour, a seventeen-year-old human tide-watcher: about 154 cm, small, slight and light on her feet, covered by her clothes. Flax-coloured hair in one short braid whose tip is bleached pale by salt water. Eyes the deep blue of the open sea, which often look past the person talking to her at the water behind. Cheeks reddened by sea wind. On her LEFT earlobe a small copper hook, the hook of the hundredth lamp, as every chain-boat child wears their family's lamp (on the viewer's right when she faces us). A quiet, soft-spoken, watchful air; when she speaks you have to lean in.
palette: sea blue and sail-canvas ochre, flax gold, salt-white, dull copper
casual: Her clothes on the chain boat: an old canvas short jacket patched at the cuffs over a long-sleeved linen shirt and a plain dark skirt to the ankle; a short length of iron chain tied at her waist as a weight; her boots tied together by the laces and hung round her neck, since once aboard she goes barefoot; the copper lamp-hook on her left ear. She stands with her hands loose, looking a little past the viewer, a quiet look.
private: Ashore in the harbour house: a long-sleeved plain wool dress to the ankle and a knitted shawl, the braid pinned up, soft shoes on her feet. She holds a small tide-reckoning notebook in both hands, a calm, thoughtful look.
battle: On the deck of the boat in rough water: the canvas short jacket buttoned up, long trousers under a canvas skirt tied at the knee, boots hung round her neck. She holds a heavy coil of mooring line in both hands, the iron chain end at her waist, her eyes on the swell.
battle_pose: 3) the chain-boat outfit: crouched and braced on the deck, both hands hauling a coil of mooring line, a serious, concentrated look, her eyes on the water; she does not fight.
formal: At the harbour's night of lamp-lighting: a clean canvas short jacket with neat cuffs over a long-sleeved dark blue linen blouse and a plain dark skirt to the ankle, a short length of iron chain at her waist, boots tied together by the laces and hung over her shoulder, the copper lamp-hook on her ear. A small chain-link charm at her wrist glows with a drop of lamplight. She stands barefoot-ready with her hands folded in front, a serious, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the eyes open and serious, looking straight at the viewer, mouth closed. Pale grey sea light from one side and one warm lamp glow from behind. Foreground blur: drifting salt spray and a link of old chain. She wears the patched canvas jacket.

name: 斯迪格
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:521
who: Stig of the deep-well branch of the dwarves of the Furnace City, a hundred and sixty-one-year-old ram-hand on a salt-sea warship: about 138 cm, short and very broad, standing at the prow like a stump of old oak driven into the deck. Copper-red beard braided in three strands, a single white lock in the middle strand, pressed white a hundred years ago by a cave-in. His LEFT ear is flattened from a hundred years of pressing it to rock walls (on the viewer's right when he faces us). Amber eyes that open wider in the dark than in the light. Forearms thicker than most men's legs. A stolid, unseasick, immovable air; the roughest sea does not move him.
build: 138 cm, short and extremely broad: a deep barrel chest, arms thicker than a man's legs, a low centre of gravity.
palette: copper-red and one white lock, amber, oilcloth yellow-brown, tarred rope, dull iron
casual: His everyday wear on deck: a heavy oilcloth apron over a leather jerkin, a rolled and knotted sounding line and a lead weight hung at his belt, each knot on the line standing for one depth he has measured, thick wool trousers, and the iron-nailed mine boots he refuses to change though the sailors complain they scratch the deck. Hands loose, a stolid look.
private: Off watch below deck: a plain thick wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, a leather waistcoat, the oilcloth apron hung on a peg, felt slippers over wool socks. He runs the sounding line through his fingers, counting the knots, a calm, content look.
battle: At the ram on the warship's prow: the oilcloth apron over the leather jerkin laced tight, iron-capped gloves, the nailed boots planted wide on the planks. He braces his shoulder against the heavy brace-pole of the crystal-cartridge ram, both thick arms locked round it, the lead weight swinging at his belt, a grim, immovable look.
formal: At the fleet's roll-call: a clean dark blue wool coat of the fleet over the leather jerkin, the beard combed and braided anew with its white lock showing, the sounding line coiled neatly at his belt, the nailed boots oiled. He stands with his arms folded and his feet apart, a gruff, dignified look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the amber eyes wide in dim light, looking at the viewer with a stolid, steady look, the white lock in the red beard sharp in the frame. Cold grey sea light from one side and a lantern glow below. Foreground blur: a knotted sounding line and drifting spray. He wears the oilcloth apron.

name: 芙罗妮
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:661
who: Froni, a seventeen-year-old human net-hanger and wind-watcher from the village under the old overhang in the Floating Stone canyon: about 157 cm, small and wiry, strong-armed, covered by her clothes. Honey-coloured short hair blown into spikes by the mountain wind. Moss-green eyes. A thin white scar across the bridge of her nose from scraping a stone when she climbed a rope as a child. Cheeks reddened by wind and hands covered in rope calluses. Around her neck on a cord a small lead plumb weight, the one the village hung under the overhang to watch which way the stones drift; she took it with her the day she came down. A bold, restless, unafraid air.
palette: honey gold and moss green, chalk white, faded linen, rope hemp brown, dull lead grey
casual: Her clothes in the canyon: an old leather waistcoat over a washed-pale linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, long dark trousers tucked into climbing boots, a bundle of fine rope and a lump of white chalk at her belt, and the small lead plumb weight on its cord at her neck. She stands with one thumb hooked in the rope at her belt, a bright, cheeky look.
private: At home in the village: a loose long-sleeved linen shirt and a long plain wool skirt over trousers, soft shoes, the lead weight still at her neck. She dangles a bit of chalk on a string to watch the draught, a calm, curious look.
battle: Hanging on the cargo net across the canyon: the leather waistcoat buckled tight over the linen shirt, leather gloves, fine rope looped over her shoulder, the lead plumb weight swinging from its cord. Upside down in the net, one hand holding a white chalk mark on a stone, the other on the rope, her eyes on the drifting rocks.
battle_pose: 3) the net-hanger outfit: hanging by her knees from a rope, steady and unafraid, one hand marking a stone with white chalk, the other gripping the rope, a sharp, focused look; she does not fight.
formal: At the anchor-stone town's fair: a clean long-sleeved green wool dress to the ankle with a leather waistcoat laced over it, a small white ribbon at the neck, the lead weight on its cord, her short hair combed flat. She stands with her hands behind her back, a bright, serious look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the eyes open and serious, looking at the viewer, mouth closed. Hard bright mountain daylight from one side. Foreground blur: a fraying rope and drifting white chalk dust. She wears the leather waistcoat.

name: 凯特尔
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:716
who: Kettle of the Furnace Vein branch of the dwarves of the Furnace City, a hundred and ninety-year-old tower-furnace smith at the research institute ring: about 137 cm, short and wide, with a thick chest. A red beard braided in a single plait down to his belly, a copper furnace-door nail threaded through its middle, the tip singed brown. The LEFT eyebrow burnt half away (on the viewer's right when he faces us), the right one whole. Pale gold eyes whose pupils are rimmed with white from staring into fire. Both forearms covered with old burn scars, and on the LEFT forearm one fresh pink burn (on the viewer's right when he faces us). A silent, patient air: ask him ten things and he answers with a grunt. In every panel and in the portrait the LEFT eyebrow is clearly drawn as only a short inner stub, its outer half burnt away to bare pink skin (on the viewer's right when he faces us), while the right eyebrow is full and bushy; the two brows must not match.
build: 137 cm, short and wide: a thick deep chest able to draw in a whole furnace's heat, heavy forearms and hard hands.
palette: furnace red and soot black, pale gold, scorched brown leather, dull iron, ember orange
casual: His everyday wear at the tower furnace: a leather apron burned through in several places over a coarse wool shirt of the Furnace City, thick sleeves rolled to the elbow, a long-handled iron shovel and a pair of fire tongs at his belt, iron-toed boots with thick soles for walking on hot floor. Hands loose and soot-black, a stolid look.
private: Resting beside the furnace after his shift: the apron off, a sleeveless soot-stained linen undershirt over his scarred arms, wool trousers, the iron-toed boots off and thick socks on. He sits cross-legged on the floor and warms his big hands at the furnace door, a quiet, drowsy look.
battle: Defending the furnace in the tower: the burnt leather apron buckled tight, leather gauntlets to the elbow, a leather cap, the iron-toed boots planted wide. He holds the long iron shovel and the fire tongs crossed in front of his chest, the furnace glowing red behind him, a hard, silent look.
formal: At the tower's night of first-fire: a clean dark charcoal wool coat of the Furnace City buttoned to the throat, a short red sash, the beard freshly braided with its copper nail, his boots blacked. He stands with his hands at his sides, a solemn, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the pale gold eyes looking at the viewer with a silent, unmoved look, the copper nail in the red beard catching the light. Hard orange furnace light from one side. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and the glowing edge of a furnace door. He wears the burnt leather apron.

name: 皮欧妮
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:771
who: Peony, a thirty-eight-year-old halfling calculator of the research institute at the Star Ring: about 101 cm, short and round, a halfling's childlike proportions and soft round face, small steady hands. Fluffy cherry-red curls with a charcoal pencil tucked behind them at the back. Mint-green eyes. A smudge of ink on the tip of her nose that she wipes off and gets again. All ten fingers grey with charcoal, the dirt never quite out of her nails. A quick, absorbed, muttering air: ask her something while she is working a table and she answers with a number. Fully covered by her clothes.
palette: cherry red and mint green, charcoal grey, institute grey wool, small brass bell, paper cream
casual: Her everyday wear at the institute: a long grey wool institute robe with the hem cut short by a hand-width so she does not tread on it, closed down the front with buttons, over a plain skirt and soft boots; a small brass bell from the wagon train hung at her belt which rings with each step, which she says keeps her walking straight; a thick rubbing-paper notebook stitched with the rubbings of the torn pages tucked under her arm. The charcoal pencil behind her curls. A bright, abstracted look.
private: Late at night in the institute's long room: the grey robe unbuttoned over a plain long-sleeved linen blouse and skirt, soft slippers, the curls loose. She counts on her charcoal-grey fingers, a sleepy, content look.
battle: Working the figures for a tower on the day of its lift: the grey institute robe belted tight, sleeves tied back, the little brass bell silent in her fist, the charcoal pencil raised, the notebook under her arm, her eyes racing.
battle_pose: 3) the calculation outfit: standing, one hand holding up the charcoal pencil, the other hand holding the open notebook against her chest, a sharp, focused look with her lips moving; she does not fight.
formal: At the institute's yearly funding table: a grey institute coat in wool with the hem cut short by a hand-width, left open over a plain skirt, a white linen kerchief at the throat instead of a collar, a small brass wagon bell at her belt, the curls pinned with a brass pin. A slim crystal-tipped stylus replaces the pencil, and a few faint figure-lines drift above the notebook she holds to her chest. She stands on her toes, a proud, nervous look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the mint-green eyes bright as she looks up from a column of numbers, the ink smudge on her nose. Cold white light from a high window on one side, warm lamp glow from the other. Foreground blur: charcoal dust and the edge of a rubbing-paper page. She wears the grey institute robe.

name: 霍斯特
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:914
who: Horst of the Silver-Mane family, a forty-year-old human knight on the south gate wall of the White Kite knight city: about 186 cm, tall and lean with a back as straight as a lance. Short silver-grey hair, the colour the Silver-Mane family are born with, both temples gone fully white. A wind-hardened face with high cheekbones and an old scar through his LEFT eyebrow, made by his own lance shaft at sixteen (on the viewer's right when he faces us). Steel-blue eyes that always glance at the southern sky before they look at you. A stern, patient, loyal air; he stands on the gate longer than the battlements do.
build: 186 cm, tall and lean with broad shoulders; his legs slightly bowed from thirty years of riding, but standing he is straighter than anyone.
palette: silver-grey and steel blue, worn white and old steel, leather brown, brass key
casual: His everyday wear on the gate: an old suit of White Kite knight's plate armour, the white kite emblem on the breastplate rubbed down to a shadow, never replaced by the Dawn Empire's crest; a plain dark surcoat over a chain shirt; a White Kite long sword at his left hip; a brass key on a cord round his neck for the room above the gate where a brass-clasped oak chest sits. He stands very straight, helmet under his arm, a stern, patient look. The emblem is a gold kite, the bird of prey with spread wings.
private: Off duty in his room above the gate: a plain long-sleeved wool shirt and dark trousers with house boots, the brass key still at his neck. He sits with a tin cup of tea, looking south through the window slit, a quiet, thoughtful look.
battle: Ready at the gate before the charge: the old White Kite plate armour buckled complete, its surface dull and dark with scuffs, the white kite on the breastplate rubbed down to a faint shadow, faded rune lines along the pauldrons, no helm. A long lance held upright in his right hand, a round shield on his left arm. He stands square on both feet, a hard, level look.
formal: On the tournament field before the gate: the old White Kite plate rubbed to a dull matte, polished only enough that the worn kite shows faintly as a shadow on the breastplate, a long white kite cloak with a frayed hem thrown over his left shoulder, no new crest, the brass key at his neck. A thin line of old rune work still glints along the gorget. He stands with one gloved hand on his sword hilt, a grave, dignified look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the steel-blue eyes looking just off toward the south and then at the viewer, a stern, level look, the old scar through the left brow sharp. Cold blue dawn light from one side, warm gate-torch glow from the other. Foreground blur: a stone battlement edge and drifting mist. He wears the old White Kite armour.

name: 伊希莱
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:970
who: Ishile, a sixty-one-year-old human lake-keeper of the stone house at the Starlake: about 154 cm, small and slightly stooped, with wiry arms and strong shoulders from poling a boat. A long silver-white braid coiled on top of her head and fastened with a bone pin. Blue-grey eyes that light up when she watches the stars at night, the same pair as those in the old portrait of Otili. A face with deep lines from the lake wind, hands covered in old rope marks. A calm, careful, few-worded air. She wears no glasses.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old woman's weathered face, deep lines across the forehead and at the eyes and mouth, high cheekbones; calm blue-grey eyes that light up under thin silver brows; a small straight nose; a thin, composed mouth; a little ruddy colour on the cheeks from the lake wind.
build: 154 cm, small and slightly stooped with a slight frame: strong sinewy forearms and shoulders from poling a boat, a small bust and a narrow waist.
palette: silver white and blue-grey, oilcloth olive-brown, small brass bell, lamp gold, bone
casual: Her everyday wear: an oilcloth lake-keeper's cloak with a ring of small brass bells sewn round the collar that jingle when the wind rises, over a plain long wool dress; a bone whistle at her belt, Otili's own, handed down for five thousand years; in her hand a brass lamp whose shade is polished bright. Sturdy boots, a patient look.
private: In the stone house by the lake: the cloak off, a plain long-sleeved grey wool dress with a knitted shawl, the braid pinned up, soft felt shoes. She holds a cup of hot water in both hands near the stove, a calm, drowsy look.
battle: Guiding a boat across the lake by night: the oilcloth cloak buttoned to the throat, leather gloves, the bone whistle on its cord, the brass lamp raised high on a pole. She stands braced at the stern with a long punting pole, the lamp lighting the black water, a calm, unblinking look.
battle_pose: 3) the lake-keeper outfit: standing at the stern of a flat boat in the dark, both hands on a long punting pole and the brass lamp hung at the bow, the bells of her collar swinging, a steady, watchful look; she does not fight.
formal: On the festival night when the lamps are lit on the lake: the oilcloth cloak brushed clean and clasped with a bone pin, a ring of small brass bells polished round the collar that chime in the wind, over a dark blue wool dress with a bone-white sash, the silver braid freshly coiled. The bone whistle at her belt, the brass lamp on its pole in her hand, a few lake-water ripples running slowly along the cloak hem. She stands tall for her size, a quiet, dignified look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the blue-grey eyes lit as she looks up at the stars and then down at the viewer. Warm lamp light from one side and cold starlight from the other. Foreground blur: the dark lake water and the brass lamp's flame. She wears the oilcloth cloak with its small bells.

name: 诺薇娅
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:1026
who: Novia, a sixteen-year-old human fisher's daughter of the Starlake and an apprentice star-watcher: about 156 cm, thin and not tall, covered by her clothes. Tangled short light-blue hair, a nose reddened by the cold, and purple eyes opened wide when she looks at the sky. Frost often clings to her eyelashes from lying too long on the bridge at night. A slender, restless, upward-looking air; her neck grew from tilting up.
palette: light blue and violet, patched fisher brown, star-board pale wood, frost white
casual: Her clothes: a fisher's short coat patched over and over, the cuffs worn through, over a long-sleeved wool dress to the ankle and dark stockings; on her back, tied with rope, the wooden board carved with stars, which she carries everywhere; a small knife at her belt for carving the board; warm boots. She stands looking up, her eyes wide.
private: At home in the fisher's house: a long-sleeved plain wool dress to the ankle, a thick knitted cardigan, soft felt slippers, the short hair tousled. She holds a mug of warm milk and the half-carved star board on her lap, a sleepy, dreamy look.
battle: Out on the night bridge: the patched fisher's coat buttoned to the throat, a long scarf, mittens, boots, the carved star board held up in one hand with its rope hanging loose from it and the small knife in the other hand; nothing is tied on her back, there is only this one board, her face tipped up to the sky.
battle_pose: 3) the star-watcher outfit: standing with the feet apart, the carved star board held up in both hands, one eye narrowed as if sighting a star, a serious, focused look; she does not fight.
formal: At the lake festival where the new star-watchers are named: a clean long-sleeved dark blue wool dress to the ankle with a white collar, her hair combed flat, the star board tied across her back with a fresh cord. She stands very straight with her hands folded, a serious, wide-eyed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the eyes open and wide, looking straight at the viewer, mouth closed. Cold starlight from above on one side, a faint warm lantern glow from the other. Foreground blur: frost crystals and the edge of the carved star board. She wears the patched fisher's coat.
art_extra: Her hair stays pale sky-blue in the portrait, lit but not tinted violet; only her eyes are purple.

name: 罗特鲁德
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:1082
who: Rotrude, a seventeen-year-old human flower-picker's daughter from the Flower Valley who will become a swordswoman: about 168 cm, tall and slender, covered by her clothes. Cherry-pink long hair in one braid, the end pinned with a single dried rose. Emerald-green eyes that meet your look without dodging. Small white thorn-prick marks over her fingers. A direct, quiet, steady air.
palette: cherry pink and rose red, emerald green, undyed rough cloth, rattan brown, dried petal rose
casual: Her clothes: a long-sleeved rough-woven cloth dress to the ankle, belted with a rose-red cloth band; a small cloth pouch at her belt filled with dried petals, picked the autumn her brother left; a thin sword made by the valley's smith in a scabbard she wove herself from rattan strips, held in her right hand point down; sturdy boots. The dried rose pinned at the end of her braid.
private: At home among the flower fields: a loose long-sleeved linen blouse and a long plain skirt to the ankle, a straw hat, soft shoes. She holds a basket of fresh roses against her side, a calm, gentle look.
battle: Training in the flower field: the long-sleeved rough dress belted tight with the rose-red band, leather bracers, tall boots, the braid tied back. She holds the thin sword in both hands at the ready, point forward, the rattan scabbard at her belt, rose petals scattering round her feet, a clear, serious look.
formal: At the valley's harvest festival: a long-sleeved rose-red dress of rough-woven cloth to the ankle with a green sash and plain laced front, a wreath of dried roses in her hair beside the braid, the pouch of petals at her belt, a narrow rattan scabbard slung across her back. A few of the roses on the wreath are living and keep blooming. She stands with her hands folded in front, a steady, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the eyes open and serious, looking straight at the viewer, mouth closed. Soft warm evening sun from one side. Foreground blur: drifting rose petals and a rose branch. She wears the rough cloth dress with its rose-red band.

name: 岑瓦
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:1225
who: Tsenva, a ten-year-old boy of the long-lived demon-kin from the Plain of Ten Thousand Horns, chosen as a child: about 132 cm, thin and pale. Grey-white hair; no horns and no scales, faintly pointed ear tips, so strangers take him for an elf child. Dark red eyes that begin to glow at night. On the cuff of his LEFT sleeve a small square of embroidery, his name, in stitches fine as hair, done by Tiona (on the viewer's right when he faces us). A quiet, serious, unblinking air, a child who looks at grown-ups the way grown-ups look.
palette: grey-white and dark red, undyed grey hemp, thread-fine white embroidery
casual: His clothes: a long, undyed grey hemp robe of the long-lived folk with wide sleeves, closed down the front with buttons, belted with a plain cord, plain dark leggings and soft boots; on the cuff of the left sleeve the small name embroidery. He stands with his hands at his sides, a quiet, serious look.
private: In the camp at dusk: a loose long-sleeved grey wool tunic and dark trousers, soft shoes, the name patch on the left cuff. He sits with a small wooden spoon and a bowl, a calm, thoughtful look.
battle: Waiting out the night in the camp, alert: the grey hemp robe belted tight, a short dark cloak, soft boots, the left cuff patch visible. He holds a shuttered lantern low in both hands, his dark red eyes faintly glowing, a calm, unblinking look.
battle_pose: 3) the night-watch outfit: standing very still in the dark, holding a small shuttered lantern low in both hands, the dark red eyes faintly glowing, a steady, serious look; he does not fight.
formal: On the day of the banquet he was chosen for: a clean pale grey hemp robe of the long-lived folk with wide sleeves, left open at the chest over a white undershirt and held by a plain cord belt, the hair combed flat, the left cuff freshly embroidered with a name in white thread that gives off a faint glow. Soft boots, a short dark cloak folded over one arm. He stands very upright with his hands together in front, a grave, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the dark red eyes open and calm, glowing faintly as dusk falls, mouth closed. Cold blue dusk light from one side and a small warm camp fire from the other. Foreground blur: drifting dust and a thread of white embroidery. He wears the grey hemp robe.
